known_metric_defect_yaw_drift.finding: yaw_drift=177.1 is a METRIC BUG, not a policy defect. The metric (train_and_eval.py:148-150) accumulates abs(degrees(yaw)) where yaw is the ABSOLUTE base heading (atan2 from quaternion), NOT the yaw drift relative to episode start, and does not wrap angles. For a policy that walks straight with vx_err~0.24 (good forward tracking) and lat_drift~0.37 (good), a 177deg absolute-heading accumulation is physically inconsistent -> it is the metric accumulating raw heading without wrap/relative-baseline. Same pattern as the iter-7 reference-mismatch: the metric measured the wrong quantity.
known_metric_defect_yaw_drift.evidence: physical inconsistency: yaw_drift=177deg cannot coexist with vx_err=0.24 + lat_drift=0.37 (a robot that rotated 177deg would not track forward velocity at 0.5 m/s with low lateral drift).
known_metric_defect_yaw_drift.fix_needed: compute yaw_drift as the wrapped change in heading from episode start (or the yaw ANGULAR VELOCITY base_ang_vel[2]), not abs(absolute heading).
